name: linear-dark
title: Linear Dark
description: Precision dark-mode engineering with quiet surfaces, restrained indigo accents, dense typography, and hairline boundaries.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.monospaceFamily: Berkeley Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

rules: Build depth with adjacent neutral surfaces and 1px borders before adding shadow.
Reserve the indigo accent for primary actions, selection, and focused states.
Keep body copy at 13–16px and use weight or color—not arbitrary size jumps—to establish hierarchy.
Use no more than three font weights in a component tree.
Apply tabular numbers to metrics, timestamps, prices, identifiers, and data tables.
Keep interactive controls between 32px and 40px high unless density requirements say otherwise.
Use 6px or 8px radii for controls and cards; reserve full radii for pills and avatars.
Never introduce purple gradients, neon glows, glassmorphism, or decorative blur.
Align labels, values, and controls to the 4px spacing grid and a shared content edge.
Motion must clarify state changes and finish within 160ms for direct manipulation.
